title: Ashiok | Planeswalker
description: Learn more about how Ashiok, a Planeswalker in Magic: The Gathering, terrorizes foes with their fears and nightmares.

paragraphs.text: Ashiok is an elegant being of nightmare who draws on fear, creating twisted physical manifestations of each victim's darkest dreams. Ashiok's motives and origin are unknown, but most who encounter this sinister entity quickly conclude that some mysteries are better left untouched.
